item.title: Uncommon Sense Teaching: The Brain-Based Strategies Every Teacher Needs
item.description: Unlock science-backed teaching strategies from Uncommon Sense Teaching in Episode 235 of the Shake Up Learning Show. Learn how to improve student learning, boost retention, and support struggling learners with practical, classroom-ready tips for all grade levels.

item.title: 5 Practical Ways Teachers Can Balance Tech Without Burnout
item.description: Discover 5 practical and realistic tips to help teachers manage screen time, reduce digital overwhelm, and find a healthier tech-work balance. Learn how to use educational technology with intention—without letting it take over your day.

item.title: 20 Fresh, Low-Tech Ideas for Teachers
item.description: Discover 20 low-tech teaching strategies that boost engagement and reduce screen time. Perfect for back-to-school or anytime you need a tech break. Includes a free “Offline Instagram” reflection template!

item.title: Offline Instagram Reflection FREE Template
item.description: Looking for a fun, low-tech activity that still taps into your students’ creativity and interest in social media—without the screen time? This Offline Instagram Reflection Template provides a simple way to make learning visible, promote reflection, and deepen comprehension.

item.title: Dynamic Learning 2.0: A Framework for What’s Next (Part 1)
item.description: Explore the first 3 of 6 critical shifts in this updated Dynamic Learning Framework 2.0 for 2025. Discover practical strategies for flexible learning time, interdisciplinary exploration, and safe global connections. Perfect for K–12 teachers ready to refresh classroom practices with purpose-driven tech and student-centered learning.

item.title: Dynamic Learning 2.0: A Framework for What’s Next (Part 2)
item.description: Discover how the refreshed Dynamic Learning Framework reflects the evolving needs of today’s classrooms. In Part 2 of this series, Kasey Bell explores 3 key shifts: purposeful tech use, ongoing growth, and sustainable teaching practices.

item.title: The Best Chrome Extensions for Teachers
item.description: Save time & boost efficiency with 8 free Chrome extensions for teachers! Kasey Bell from Shake Up Learning shares her top tools for organization, feedback (MOTE), lesson design (InsertLearning), and classroom accessibility.

item.title: 6 AI-Powered Ways to Engage Students Before the Holiday Break
item.description: Survive—and thrive—the week before a school break with these 6 AI-powered classroom management strategies! Discover how AI tools like ChatGPT and MagicSchool can help you reduce chaos, boost student engagement, and save your sanity.

item.title: AI-Generated Slide Decks for Teachers: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly
item.description: Tired of spending hours building slide decks from scratch? In this episode, we’re diving into four FREE AI tools that fully generate your teaching presentations—text, images, and structure included. I’ll walk you through the good, the bad, and the downright ugly of using AI to create classroom or training slides, with real talk on what works for busy educators. Whether you’re prepping a lesson, webinar, or PD session, find out which tools actually save you time—and which ones aren’t worth it.
